rationale: The bounded change introduces product semantics and spans three canonical owners and three source paths. It is ineligible for verified_change because ownership is not singular and propagation is not deterministic. compact_delivery is also unsupported because the fixture does not establish a completed Brownfield analysis or stored quick_task context. With no broader runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, API, CLI, release, or cross-host impact in the supplied evidence, structured_slice is the smallest supported non-authorizing candidate.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement only.
deterministic_validation is true, but deterministic_propagation is false.
verified_change requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation when derived paths exist; those tests
compact_delivery requires visible approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, and stored quick_task context; only the UR
No supplied impact exists for runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, external API, CLI contract, release,
Any broader impact than the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
